shop.name: Sweet Crumbs
shop.description: Home bakery in Baner, Pune. Cakes, brownies and cupcakes baked to order.
shop.tone: Warm and polite, with a little more detail than a one-liner. Uses 'ji' in Hindi and Hinglish.

products.name: Chocolate Truffle Cake
products.notes: Order at least 2 days in advance. A custom message on the cake is free.

products.name: Red Velvet Cake
products.notes: Order at least 2 days in advance. A custom message on the cake is free.

products.name: Brownie Box
products.notes: Baked fresh; order 1 day in advance. Contains wheat flour, dairy, eggs, and walnuts.

products.name: Cupcake Box
products.notes: Baked fresh; order 1 day in advance. Choose vanilla, chocolate, or a mix.

policies.title: Advance notice
policies.body: Cakes need at least 2 days' notice. Brownies and cupcakes need 1 day's notice.

policies.title: Delivery area and charge
policies.body: Free delivery within 5 km of Baner for orders of ₹800 and above. ₹50 delivery charge for orders below ₹800 within 5 km. Beyond 5 km, the customer arranges pickup or a delivery partner.

policies.title: Advance payment
policies.body: 50% advance by UPI to confirm a cake order. The balance is paid on delivery by UPI or cash.

policies.title: Cancellation
policies.body: If a cake order is cancelled within 24 hours of the delivery time, the advance is not refunded.

policies.title: Open days and hours
policies.body: Open 9 AM to 7 PM, Tuesday to Sunday. Closed on Mondays.

sample_replies.customer_message: Can I get 'Happy Birthday Riya' written on the cake?
sample_replies.reply: Of course! A custom message on the cake is free of charge. Just share the exact text when you place the order.

sample_replies.customer_message: Cupcake ka box kitne ka hai?
sample_replies.reply: Ji, 6 cupcakes ka box ₹360 ka hai. Vanilla, chocolate ya mix, jo aapko pasand ho.
